g.text: Collation is the runtime’s, not the repo’s.
The ICU build on the machine that ran the
script picks the order. Nothing pins it.
No tracked diff.
The file never enters git, so a reordered
build is invisible in review.
One-way door.
Reassigning it later breaks every link
already out in the world.
